meta.name: TECNOFEUDO RADAR
meta.brief: Vigilância como infraestrutura de poder, lida de dentro: radar, câmera, sigilo e painel de terreno. Resistência visual: o sistema é exposto, medido e devolvido ao público.

contract.concept: Vigilância como infraestrutura de poder, lida de dentro: radar, câmera, sigilo e painel de terreno. Resistência visual: o sistema é exposto, medido e devolvido ao público.
contract.audienceEffect: O público deve sentir Vigilância como infraestrutura de poder, lida de dentro: radar, câmera, sigilo e painel de terreno.
contract.visualLanguage: Concept fracture: verbs fracture, fragment, scatter, pulse; motifs fault lines, shards, scattered marks, beat stamp; one dominant figure per composition over a quiet ground.
contract.formLanguage: Forms follow the hero generator of each composition; the structure layer keeps one module and one grid.
contract.materialLanguage: Light on a dark ground: glass, concrete; shards, tiles.
contract.colorLogic: analogous scheme, OKLCH hue 250 (cold steel and signal blue); one accent used for events only.
contract.spatialLogic: Canvas 3840x1920 (led); the hero sits on the focal zone, structure on the grid, information at the edge.
contract.motionLanguage: Profile: stepped, quantised to the beat grid; springy (zeta 0.8082, 1% overshoot); with a wind-up dip before each hit; 16 move(s) per loop of 4 bar(s), so the loop closes. Played as layer.mod spring curves (scripts/motion_profiles.py). Animation IR archetypes: stutter, pulse, ripple, stutter (quantised, hard steps on the beat; everything moves together, nothing rings).
contract.typographyLanguage: Uppercase, one family; text only when the brief supplies exact words.
contract.temporalArc: whole, stress, break, scatter, residue; tension, snap, aftermath; over 4 bars per composition, the set follows whole, stress, fracture, scatter.
contract.loopGrammar: cyclic: the loop closes on whole bars and every layer moves in whole cycles
contract.technicalStrategy: Generated without AI by brief_to_project.py from the structured brief; native pixels, deterministic seed, engine generators only.
contract.forbiddenShortcuts: neon glow, lens flares, partículas aleatórias
contract.focalEvent: A varredura do radar trava um alvo e o quadro desloca em glitch
contract.releaseZone: The ground field and the empty third of the frame; no layer fills it.
contract.banned: neon glow, lens flares, partículas aleatórias

artBible.thesis: Vigilância como infraestrutura de poder, lida de dentro: radar, câmera, sigilo e painel de terreno. Resistência visual: o sistema é exposto, medido e devolvido ao público.
artBible.material: Light on a dark ground (industrial, glitch, aggressive); glass, concrete; shards, tiles; no fake materials, no gradients that pretend to be objects.
artBible.space: Read from far away: heavy strokes, large forms, the hero on the focal third, information at the edge.
artBible.motion: Profile: stepped, quantised to the beat grid; springy (zeta 0.8082, 1% overshoot); with a wind-up dip before each hit; 16 move(s) per loop of 4 bar(s), so the loop closes. Played as layer.mod spring curves (scripts/motion_profiles.py). Animation IR archetypes: stutter, pulse, ripple, stutter (quantised, hard steps on the beat; everything moves together, nothing rings).
artBible.dramaturgy: whole, stress, break, scatter, residue; tension, snap, aftermath; over 4 bars per composition, the set follows whole, stress, fracture, scatter. Tension: assertive; one dominant figure per composition; the ground field is the release.
artBible.color: analogous scheme, OKLCH hue 250 (cold steel and signal blue); one accent used for events only.
artBible.typography: No text unless the brief supplies exact words; if added: uppercase, one family, three sizes at most.
artBible.audio: Strategy structural: the music drives structure and scale, never every hit.
artBible.banned: neon glow, lens flares, partículas aleatórias
